name: Graco Inc.
moat_justification: Strong niche moat: ROIC proxy stayed 24.6-37.2% over FY2019-2025 (25.0% in FY2025) with gross margin 49.3-53.1% through the cycle, pricing power and mission-critical installed base in Contractor/Industrial fluid handling; capped at 7 because growth is low-single-digit organic, end markets are cyclical, and Nordson/EXEL/Asian rivals contest every niche.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
one_liner: High-quality compounder, moat 7/10 — does not clear 15% at $81.99 (weighted IRR 7.6%, IV@15% $32.71); clears 15% only below ~$32.71.
moat_for: ROIC proxy 24.6-37.2% FY2019-2025, well above cost of capital through a cycle
Gross margin 49.3-53.1% for seven straight years — proven pricing power
Mission-critical niche specialization (difficult fluids, precision dispensing) with high switching costs and 500+ patents
Leading share (~20-25% core segments) and global service/distribution network
Net-cash balance sheet (-$622M net debt) funding buybacks and bolt-on M&A through downturns
moat_against: Low-single-digit organic growth — Q2 2026 organic sales -1%, guidance low-single-digit for 2026
Cyclical Contractor (construction/housing) and Industrial capex exposure
Competition from Nordson, EXEL Industries and lower-cost Asian entrants
Growth increasingly acquisition-bought (COROB, Radia, Valco Melton) — integration and goodwill risk
Tariff and input-cost exposure; Q2 2026 margin helped by $9M of tariff refunds that will not repeat cleanly
